title.narrative: South Asia Subregional Economic Cooperation Dhaka-Northwest Corridor Road Project, Phase 2 - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The project will improve the road connectivity and efficiency of Dhaka-Northwest international trade corridor. To ensure the sustainability of the outcome, an associated technical assistance is proposed to assist the government in updating its master plan for roads and improving its planning capacity.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Indicator Indicator: 190 km of road upgraded with climate-resilient design Achievement: 137 Progress/Status: Eight contracts (WP-06 to WP-12) have been awarded. As of 31 December 2025, the physical progress of these 8 packages is WP-6: 79.48%, WP-7: 87.26%, WP-8: 99.18%, WP-9:99.05%, WP-10: 92.93%, WP-11: 98.88%, WP- 12:99.13%. As of 31 December 2025, the overall physical progress for 11 (including 5,13,14,15 under t2,-t4) contracts was 83.78%.
The Achieved Progress of SASEC-2 (awarded contracts) up to December 2025 was 83.78 %. This delayed progress has been occurred due to less intension of the Contractors, small scaled construction, less procurement of the materials, LA issues, delayed shifting of U/G Utilities, un-demolished obstacles and COVID-19 etc. So, all Contractors have been reminded about the progress behind schedule
